evidence_boundary.current_evidence: No company impact is established by this unrun pilot kit.
evidence_boundary.pilot_purpose: Assess feasibility and describe the protocol-versus-agent-only contrast, with manual work as a secondary comparator; this crossover does not identify a controlled impact effect.
evidence_boundary.prohibited_claim: Do not state or imply that the protocol improves productivity, quality, safety, adoption, or business outcomes unless completed evidence supports that exact claim.

workflow.name: Replace with one recurring document workflow
workflow.description: Describe a low-stakes, read-only workflow that turns non-sensitive business documents into a checkable action plan.
affected_people_groups: Replace with workers or teams affected by the workflow
workflow.unit_of_work: One comparable non-sensitive document set and its action plan
workflow.current_manual_process: Describe who reads the documents, how actions are recorded, and how a human checks the result today.
in_scope: Read-only extraction from non-sensitive or redacted business documents
out_of_scope: Personal, special-category, commercially sensitive, or legally privileged material
Employment, credit, legal, health, safety-critical, or other high-impact decisions
Sending messages, updating systems, committing named workers, or taking external action

readiness.rationale: A template starts on HOLD. Change to GO only after all evidence and approvals are complete.

governance.pilot_owner_role: Replace with day-to-day pilot owner role
governance.workflow_owner_role: Replace with accountable workflow owner role
governance.affected_people_representative_role: Replace with worker or affected-team representative role

decision_rights.must_approve_output_use: The existing human workflow owner or delegated reviewer
agent_must_not_decide: Whether a worker is performing well
Whether anyone receives an employment consequence
Whether a pilot output becomes an operational commitment
Whether the pilot scales beyond its approved scope

worker_protections.consultation_note: Replace with the reason or record that the relevant worker representative was consulted.
worker_protections.consent_record_destination: Restricted company consent register, kept separately from pilot outcomes

data_governance.destination: Replace with an approved local or company-controlled restricted folder
data_governance.deletion_method: Delete pilot files and verify removal from the approved destination
data_governance.retention_rationale: Long enough to complete the 90-day follow-up and audit, then delete.

trial.seed_disclosure_rule: keep the seed sealed until data lock, then disclose it with the frozen participant list for replay
trial.agent_model_identifier: Replace with exact model and version used in both agent arms
trial.agent_configuration_path: Replace with the frozen agent-configuration JSON path
trial.bare_agent_prompt_path: Replace with the frozen ordinary-prompt text path

sample_size.calculation_note: Illustrative feasibility assumptions only: one complete six-sequence block estimates recruitment, completion, variance and interval width; it is not powered for a confirmatory effect.

carryover_controls: Use different but difficulty-matched document sets in every period.
Do not let workers copy the protocol text into the agent-only arm.
Record contamination and prior exposure for every work item.
trial.task_equivalence_method: Blindly rate and block comparable document sets by length, number of action items, ambiguity, and injection risk before allocation.
trial.preregistration_path: Replace with a frozen local analysis-plan path before enrolment

primary.unit: active human minutes per work item

secondary_and_guardrail.collection_method: Timer from work-item start to accepted output or declared stop.
Count correction cycles after the first submitted action plan.
Blinded rater applies the frozen 0 to 100 quality rubric.
Blinded count of invented, missing, mistyped, or wrongly sourced material items.
Worker rates mental effort immediately after each work item.
Worker answers a yes or no adoption question after each work item.
Count requests to the pilot owner or optional trusted adviser.
Optional facilitator records active support minutes per work item; zero for self-guided work.
Human approver and checker record active review and acceptance minutes per work item.
Derived as participant effort plus facilitator support plus approver and checker minutes.
Record measured model and tool charges in USD per work item; use null when unavailable, never an estimate presented as measured.
Count coded near misses and incidents; retain separate category and severity.

quality_measurement.disagreement_resolution_method: Retain both original ratings; adjudicate only factual material-error classification using the frozen answer key and a third role blinded to arm.

outcomes.measurement_window: from work-item start through accepted output or declared stop

analysis.primary_method: paired worker-level feasibility estimate adjusted descriptively for period and sequence; not a controlled impact effect
analysis.period_and_sequence_adjustment: Estimate the arm contrast with worker blocking and fixed effects for period, sequence, and task-family difficulty.
analysis.carryover_assessment: Report arm-by-period patterns and a prespecified prior-arm sensitivity check; do not reinterpret a carryover signal after seeing results.
analysis.missing_data_strategy: Keep every randomized worker in the flow table; report complete-pair estimates, reasons and timing, then run prespecified sensitivity bounds for missing outcomes.
analysis.attrition_reporting: report assigned, started, completed, withdrawn and lost with reasons by sequence and arm; keep pre-randomization screening outside randomized outcomes
analysis.multiplicity: one prespecified primary descriptive estimand; all other contrasts and outcomes are secondary or exploratory
analysis.uncertainty_reporting: report point estimates, 95% confidence intervals, sample counts, missing pairs, and raw arm summaries; do not use p-values alone

stop_triggers: Any severe safety event or unauthorized external action
Sensitive, personal, privileged, or out-of-scope data enter the pilot
A worker withdraws and asks for deletion of their retained pilot data
Agent configuration or protocol prompt changes during the trial
rollback_steps: Pause assignments and return the workflow to its documented manual process.
Quarantine affected outputs and prevent operational use pending review.
Record the coded incident, honor withdrawal or deletion requests, and verify restoration.
incident_and_rollback.restoration_point: The documented manual workflow and last human-approved source record before the pilot item

approvals.conditions: Confirm destination, access, retention and deletion.
Confirm stop triggers and incident route.
